page.text:
The elementary constructors do not by themselves constitute the usual
Zermelo--Fraenkel theory. Modern set theory also controls how formulas
select members of an existing set, how functional assignments produce new
sets, and how membership chains behave. These principles are stated as
schemes because one axiom is supplied for every suitable formula in the
language.
